# YuE2 request-protocol fixtures (sc-22990)

Generated by `scripts/reference/yue2/protocol_fixtures.py` from the pinned upstream
(`multimodal-art-projection/YuE` @ `92a73cc7652fcc1f937855e4b765e0a0edd7ff2e`, installed by
`scripts/reference/yue2/setup_reference_env.sh`: Python 3.12.13 / `unicodedata` 15.0.0,
tiktoken 0.12.0, numpy 2.2.6, torch 2.10.0). Every expected value is produced by upstream code —
`YuE2TextTokenizer`, `yue2.protocol`, `yue2.nar.song_chunks`, `yue2.sampling.generate_tokens`'
pre-prefill checks and `SymbolicPlan.save` — never re-implemented. Regenerating is deterministic.

| File | Contents | Checked by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `synthetic.tiktoken` | A 711-rank byte-level BPE table trained by the generator on its own corpus (Apache-2.0, ours). | the lib tests' tokenizer |
| `tokenizer_synthetic.json` | Encode / decode / prefix cases on `synthetic.tiktoken`, computed by upstream's own `YuE2TextTokenizer` constructed on it. | `tokenizer::tests`, `protocol::tests` (CI) |
| `tokenizer_qwen.json` | The same cases on the pinned `qwen.tiktoken` (`m-a-p/YuE2-3B` @ `1a96eca688d6ae5d7f0feb88573fec89920fcd19`, SHA-256 `b2b1b8df…3186`). | `tests/protocol_real.rs` (`YUE2_HF_HUB`) |
| `protocol_cases.json` | Accept / refuse and resolved values for sampling overrides, `GenerationConfig.from_dict`, `SongRequest`, `chunk_ranges`, the generation budget, and Python's `str.isspace` set. | `protocol::tests` (CI) |
| `plans/`, `plans.json` | Plans saved by upstream `SymbolicPlan.save` (synthetic tokenizer): full / generated, melody / generated and truncated mid-character, melody / external ABC with CFG, cot off. | `plan::tests` (CI) |

`qwen.tiktoken` itself is **not** committed: it carries the Tongyi Qianwen License Agreement and
the crate's licence policy (`src/license.rs`) gates redistribution of it, and this repository is
public. The synthetic table exercises the identical code path — upstream's class runs on it
(padded to the 151643 ordinary tokens it insists on with `\xff`-prefixed fillers no UTF-8 text can
reach), so the pre-tokenizer, NFC, rank-ordered merging, special tokens and prefixes are upstream's
— and the real-table parity runs against the pinned snapshot:

```sh
YUE2_HF_HUB=/path/to/hub YUE2_REF_PYTHON=~/.cache/sceneworks-yue2-ref/venv/bin/python \
  cargo test --release -p candle-audio-yue2 --test protocol_real -- --ignored --nocapture
```

The plan files are byte-exact (`plan_manifest.json` pins their SHA-256), so `.gitattributes` here
disables eol conversion for them.
